mapper.sql: file.sys10_file_id AS file_id, file.sys10_parent_id AS parent_id, file.sys10_file_nm AS file_nm, file.sys10_reg_date AS reg_date, file.sys10_server_path AS server_path, file.sys10_size AS size, file.sys10_note AS note, file.sys10_file_ext AS file_ext, file.sys10_file_yn AS file_yn, file.sys10_title_yn AS title_yn, file.sys10_seq AS seq
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_file_id = #{fileId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_file_id = #{fileId} ) AS file

SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ) AS file ORDER BY LPAD(COALESCE(file.sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(file.sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, file.sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu"

SELECT , file.sys10_lock_yn AS lock_yn FROM ( SELECT sys10_file.* , false AS sys10_lock_yn FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* , false AS sys10_lock_yn FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* , true AS sys10_lock_yn FROM sys10_file INNER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_journal_id = sys10_parent_id WHERE act02_tr_id IN ( SELECT ast07_tr_id FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN ast07_settle ON ast07_settle_id = act02_tr_id WHERE act02_journal_id = #{parentId} ) UNION SELECT sys10_file.* , true AS sys10_lock_yn FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id IN ( SELECT pay50_journal_id FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN ast07_settle ON ast07_settle_id = act02_tr_id INNER JOIN pay50_expense ON pay50_expense_id = ast07_expense_id WHERE act02_journal_id = #{parentId} ) ) AS file WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY COALESCE(sys10_file_yn, 'false') ASC, LPAD(COALESCE(sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT FROM flt07_family_consent INNER JOIN sys10_file AS file ON file.sys10_parent_id = flt07_family_consent_id WHERE flt07_person_id = #{personId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = flt07_person_id AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} ) ORDER BY file.sys10_file_id

SELECT FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ) AS file ORDER BY COALESCE(file.sys10_file_yn, 'false') ASC, LPAD(COALESCE(file.sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(file.sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, file.sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu"
SELECT FROM sys10_file file WHERE file.sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY file.sys10_reg_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys10_file (sys10_file_id, sys10_parent_id, sys10_file_nm, sys10_reg_date, sys10_server_path, sys10_size, sys10_note, sys10_file_ext, sys10_file_yn, sys10_admin_yn, sys10_law_type, sys10_print_yn, sys10_ext_yn) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{parentId}, #{fileNm}, f_sysdate(), #{serverPath}, #{size}, '', #{fileExt}, #{fileYn}, NULL, NULL, 'true', 'false')

INSERT INTO sys10_file (sys10_file_id, sys10_parent_id, sys10_file_nm, sys10_reg_date, sys10_server_path, sys10_size, sys10_note, sys10_file_ext, sys10_file_yn, sys10_admin_yn, sys10_law_type, sys10_print_yn, sys10_ext_yn) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{parentId}, #{fileNm}, f_sysdate(), #{serverPath}, #{size}, '', #{fileExt}, 'false', 'true', NULL, 'true', 'true')
mapper.select:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS file_id , sys01_company_nm AS company_nm , sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm , a.total_size AS total_size , ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) FROM sys10_file WHERE REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') = a.server_nm ) AS running_total_size FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') AS server_nm , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' GROUP BY REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), '') ) a INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_loc_nm = REPLACE(a.server_nm, LEFT(a.server_nm, 17), '') WHERE 1=1
AND ((#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false'))
ORDER BY a.total_size DESC, a.server_nm

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS file_id , a.year AS year , a.total_size AS total_size FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') AS year , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), ''), LEFT(REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), ''), 17), '') = #{locName} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') ) a ORDER BY a.year DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS file_id , a.month AS month , a.total_size AS total_size FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'mm') AS month , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') = #{year} AND REPLACE(REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), ''), LEFT(REPLACE(sys10_server_path, RIGHT(sys10_server_path, 7), ''), 17), '') = #{locName} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'mm') ) a ORDER BY a.month DESC

SELECT t.sys10_file_id AS file_id , t.sys10_parent_id AS parent_id , t.sys10_file_nm AS file_nm , t.sys10_reg_date AS reg_date , t.sys10_server_path AS server_path , t.sys10_size AS size , f.sys10_file_ext AS file_ext FROM find_orphan_sys10_files() t INNER JOIN sys10_file f ON f.sys10_file_id = t.sys10_file_id ORDER BY t.sys10_reg_date, t.sys10_file_nm
